Uninstall any older Fields app first (debug builds used a different signature).

This download is a ZIP. Do not tap the ZIP to "install".

1. Open the ZIP with Files / My Files / Samsung unzip.
2. Tap Fields.apk inside.
3. Allow installs from this source.
4. If Play Protect warns, choose Install anyway.

Then open Fields and allow precise location (Allow all the time if the phone will be in a pocket).
